display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Step 1: What is the client type?
Can it keep a secret? Is it a browser?
Is there a user? What is the threat model?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Client can keep a secret (confidential)
Server-side / Backend service

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Client CANNOT keep a secret (public client)
SPA / Mobile app / Desktop app

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
No user present (machine-to-machine)
Backend / Cron job / CLI tool

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Step 2: Authorization Code flow
Redirect user to auth server, exchange code,
client auth: secret or cert

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Step 2: Authorization Code + PKCE
code_verifier + code_challenge (S256), no client_secret needed

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Step 2: Client Credentials flow
No user redirect, direct token request with client_id+secret

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Device present, no browser?
-> Device Code flow (RFC 8628)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Token types: JWT (self-contained) or opaque (needs introspection).
No refresh token (client requests new token when needed)
